premises.text: Marketers and retailers prey on hardwired hunting-and-gathering instincts, so people chronically overspend on impulse
premises.evidence_span: they have been preying on those natural human instincts, and you drop that human brain into the modern retail environment, and you have trouble, right?

premises.text: The plan-and-budget approach to personal finance has failed
premises.evidence_span: in order to do well with your finances, in order to get ahead financially, you must create a plan, you must have a budget, you must stick to that financial diet

premises.text: Users create an FDIC-insured, interest-bearing online piggy bank linked to their existing checking account wherever they bank
premises.evidence_span: they create an online piggy bank, a savings account that's FDIC-insured and interest-bearing. They then link that account to their external checking account, wherever they bank, it doesn't matter

premises.text: Users set concrete personal savings goals they care about
premises.evidence_span: a goal can be anything from an iPad, to a travel vacation, to paying down your student debt, anything that you really care about and want to make sure you make happen in your life

premises.text: At the impulse moment, a few touches move the unspent amount into savings with instant goal feedback, from any channel
premises.evidence_span: So you can impulse save from wherever you are, and you can impulse save whenever the impulse strikes you.

premises.text: Optional sharing of saves creates a bragging-based social reinforcement loop
premises.evidence_span: Sharing is not the default. But close to 40% of our users choose to share their impulse saves. It's an aspect of bragging.

premises.text: The company markets users' own goals and priorities back to them through email updates, progress updates, and push notifications
premises.evidence_span: We're actually taking your goals, your aspirations, and your priorities in your life, and we're going to use our ninja marketing skills to market those to you.

value.text: Saving is redesigned to fit people, becoming as easy and instantly gratifying as spending
value.evidence_span: we've actually changed saving to fit into people

causal_links.evidence_span: so that they can move money out of harm's way whenever they want to
people love to save money. And there's no mystery there, right? We all love to save money. But the question is, why do we suck so bad at it?
made it just as easy and as instantly gratifying to save your money as it is to spend it
So we're not just here to make saving easy.

notes: The design-philosophy claim (change saving to fit people) is coded as the value statement rather than a premise. Save-anywhere channels (Instagram, SMS, in-site) and the instant feedback message are folded into the impulse-moment premise per v1.3.2 clarification 5. Usage metrics ($3,000/year saved, two saves per week) and the matching-funds roadmap item excluded or folded per 4.2 and v1.3.2.
